title: Global Responsibility and Advocacy
summary: أهم كلمات Unit 6 (The Space We Share) بالمعنى الإنجليزي والعربي وأمثلة، وعيلات الكلمات والـ collocations وتدريبات زي المراجعات.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This page collects the **key vocabulary of Unit 6: The Space We Share**. Each word has a simple English meaning, the Arabic meaning and a short example. Then you will practise word families, collocations, prefixes and suffixes, synonyms and antonyms.

blocks.text: الصفحة دي فيها **أهم كلمات Unit 6: The Space We Share**، متقسمة حسب دروس الوحدة. الوحدة كلها عن فكرة إن **الكوكب ده مشترك** بينا وبين الحيوانات والدول التانية، وإن كل واحد عليه **مسؤولية (responsibility)**، وإن فيه ناس بتدافع **(advocate)** عن اللي مالوش صوت زي الحيوانات والبيئة.

الكلمات دي متاخدة من نصوص الوحدة وجداول الـ **Vocabulary** و**Media Analysis: Key Concepts** في الكتاب: **6.1 A World We Borrow** (الطيور المهاجرة والأراضي الرطبة)، **6.2 When Needs Compete** (الفلاح والأفيال)، **6.3 Voices for the Voiceless** (نور والسلاحف البحرية)، **6.4 Global Citizens, Local Actions** (زراعة المانجروف)، وكمان **Consolidation Review C**.
إزاي تذاكر الكلمات صح؟

text: Do not learn a word alone. Learn its **meaning in context**, its **family** (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) and the words that usually go **with** it (collocations).

blocks.text: أسئلة الكتاب والمراجعات مش بتسألك «ترجم الكلمة» وخلاص. بتحطلك الكلمة **جوه جملة** وتسألك معناها **في السياق ده** (What does … mean in this context?)، أو تطلب منك **تغيّر شكل الكلمة** (noun / adjective / adverb)، أو تطلع **مرادف أو عكس** من قطعة. علشان كده ذاكر كل كلمة بالطريقة دي:

items: **اقرا المثال الأول** وافهم الكلمة من الجملة قبل ما تبص على الترجمة.
**احفظ المعنى الإنجليزي البسيط**، لأن الاختيارات في الـ MCQ بتيجي تعريفات بالإنجليزي.
**اعرف عيلة الكلمة**: الاسم والفعل والصفة والظرف.
**اعرف الكلمة بتيجي مع إيه** (collocation) زي reach a compromise مش do a compromise.
**اكتب جملة بنفسك** عن موضوع الوحدة بكل كلمة جديدة. الكتاب بيطلب كده في Practice: Write FOUR sentences using words from the text.

blocks.text: كلمات 6.1: A World We Borrow
النص بيتكلم عن مليارات الطيور اللي بتهاجر كل خريف من أوروبا وآسيا وبتعدي فوق مصر، وإن مفيش دولة لوحدها تقدر تحميها.

items: migrate / migratory
يهاجر / مهاجر · to move from one place to another every season · مثال: **Migratory** birds fly over Egypt every autumn.
finite resources
موارد محدودة · natural things that can run out · مثال: Water and land are **finite resources**.
wetland
أرض رطبة / مستنقعات · land that is wet most of the time, like marshes · مثال: Birds rest in the **wetlands** of the Nile Delta.
staggering
مذهل / ضخم جدًا · extremely impressive or surprising in size · مثال: The number of birds was **staggering**.
stopover
محطة توقف (استراحة) · a short rest or stop during a long journey · مثال: Lake Burullus is a **stopover** for many birds.
drained
اتصرفت منه المية (اتجفف) · having had the water removed from it · مثال: The marsh was **drained** for farming.
conservationist
شخص بيحمي البيئة والحياة البرية · a person who works to protect nature and wildlife · مثال: **Conservationists** count the birds every year.
enforcement
تطبيق القانون (الإلزام بيه) · making sure people follow rules or laws · مثال: Strong **enforcement** stops illegal hunting.
tighten (budgets tighten)
تضيق / تتقلص (الميزانية) · become more limited because less money is available · مثال: When budgets **tighten**, nature projects are cut first.
ecotourism
السياحة البيئية · tourism that visits nature without harming it · مثال: **Ecotourism** brings income to local families.
negotiation
تفاوض · discussion to reach an agreement · مثال: The plan needed long **negotiation** between farmers and officials.
legitimate needs
احتياجات مشروعة (ليها حق) · needs that are fair and reasonable · مثال: Farmers and birds both have **legitimate needs**.
consequences
عواقب / نتايج · results of an action, often bad ones · مثال: The **consequences** are felt thousands of kilometres away.

blocks.text: كلمات 6.2: When Needs Compete
التسجيل بيحكي عن **Grace** الفلاحة اللي الأفيال بتدخل مزرعتها، والمشكلة إن الطرفين ليهم حق.

items: prolonged
طويل / ممتد · continuing for a long time · مثال: A **prolonged** drought pushed elephants onto farms.
trampled
داس على (واتلف) · stepped heavily on something and damaged it · مثال: Elephants **trampled** Grace's maize.
poaching
الصيد غير القانوني · illegal hunting or capturing of wild animals · مثال: **Poaching** puts elephants in danger.
(wildlife) corridor
ممر للحيوانات · a strip of land that lets animals move safely between habitats · مثال: A **wildlife corridor** connects the two forests.
uninvited
من غير دعوة / مش مرغوب فيه · arriving without being asked or wanted · مثال: Elephants are **uninvited** guests on the farm.
legal
قانوني · allowed by law · مثال: Is it **legal** to scare animals away with fire?
vegetation
النباتات (الغطاء النباتي) · plants growing in a particular area · مثال: Rain brings fresh **vegetation** to the reserve.
endangered species
أنواع مهددة بالانقراض · animals or plants that may soon disappear · مثال: Elephants are an **endangered species**.
habitat loss
فقدان الموطن الطبيعي · when animals lose the place where they live · مثال: **Habitat loss** is caused by growing towns.
coexistence
التعايش · living together in peace · مثال: Farmers and wildlife need peaceful **coexistence**.

blocks.text: كلمات 6.3: Voices for the Voiceless
قصة **نور** اللي لقت سلحفاة بحرية ميتة متلخبطة في شبكة صيد قرب الغردقة، وبدأت حملة لتنضيف الشواطئ.

items: advocate (for)
يدافع عن / يتكلم باسم · to speak publicly in support of a person or cause · مثال: Nour **advocates for** sea turtles.
voiceless
اللي مالوش صوت · unable to speak for itself · مثال: Animals are **voiceless**, so we speak for them.
tangled
متلخبط / متشبك · caught or twisted together in a confused mess · مثال: The turtle was **tangled** in a net.
discarded
مرمي (اتخلصوا منه) · thrown away because no longer wanted · مثال: **Discarded** nets kill sea animals.
campaign
حملة · an organised series of actions with a social or political goal · مثال: Her **campaign** started with one post.
lobby
يضغط على (الحكومة) · to try to persuade a government to support a cause · مثال: Turtles cannot **lobby** the government.
livelihood
مصدر الرزق / أكل العيش · a person's main way of earning money · مثال: Fishing is their **livelihood**, not a hobby.
compromise
حل وسط · an agreement where each side gives up part of what it wanted · مثال: Safer nets were a fair **compromise**.
outlast
يعيش أطول من / يفضل بعد · to continue to exist for longer than something else · مثال: The project **outlasted** her first anger.
objection
اعتراض · a reason for not agreeing · مثال: She listened to the fishermen's **objections**.
outrage
غضب شديد · a strong feeling of anger · مثال: Online **outrage** alone changes very little.
donation
تبرع · money or things given to help others · مثال: **Donations** paid for safer equipment.

blocks.text: كلمات 6.4: Global Citizens, Local Actions
ثريد على السوشيال ميديا عن متطوعين زرعوا **500 شتلة مانجروف** على ساحل البحر الأحمر، وتسجيل عن إزاي المشاريع الصغيرة بتعلّم المواطنة العالمية.

items: biodiversity
التنوع البيولوجي · the variety of plant and animal life in an area · مثال: Mangroves increase **biodiversity** on the coast.
coastal erosion
تآكل الساحل · the slow wearing away of land along the coast · مثال: Roots reduce **coastal erosion**.
conservation
الحفاظ على البيئة · protection and careful management of nature · مثال: **Conservation** needs money and people.
ecosystem
نظام بيئي · living things interacting with their environment · مثال: A wetland is a rich **ecosystem**.
stewardship
رعاية مسؤولة (أمانة) · responsible care of something entrusted to you · مثال: Students learn **stewardship** of their shoreline.
citizen science
علم المواطنين · ordinary people collecting scientific data as volunteers · مثال: Counting birds is a form of **citizen science**.
global citizenship
المواطنة العالمية · feeling responsible for the whole world, not only your country · مثال: **Global citizenship** begins with one beach.
abstract
مجرد / نظري · existing as an idea, not as something real · مثال: 'Save the planet' is too **abstract** for many people.
engagement
مشاركة / انخراط · active involvement in something · مثال: Student **engagement** grew every term.
measurable
يمكن قياسه · able to be judged using a clear standard · مثال: The project gave **measurable** results.
paralysis
شلل (عدم القدرة على التصرف) · being unable to act because you feel overwhelmed · مثال: Huge problems can cause **paralysis**.
single-handedly
لوحده (من غير مساعدة) · without any help from anyone else · مثال: No school can **single-handedly** save the ocean.
indefinitely
لأجل غير مسمى · without any fixed end point in time · مثال: The project cannot continue **indefinitely** without funds.

blocks.text: كلمات من Consolidation Review C

items: greenhouse effect
الاحتباس الحراري (تأثير الصوبة) · gases trapping heat in the atmosphere · مثال: The **greenhouse effect** makes the Earth warmer.
at an alarming rate
بمعدل مقلق · very fast in a worrying way · مثال: Trees are disappearing **at an alarming rate**.
habitat fragmentation
تقطيع الموطن الطبيعي · dividing large natural areas into small separate parts · مثال: Roads cause **habitat fragmentation**.
extinction
انقراض · when a species disappears completely · مثال: Isolation increases the risk of **extinction**.
consensus
إجماع / اتفاق عام · an agreement accepted by everyone · مثال: The meeting ended with a **consensus**.
barren ↔ fertile
أرض جرداء ↔ أرض خصبة · land that grows nothing ↔ land that grows a lot · مثال: The **barren** land slowly became **fertile**.

blocks.text: عيلة الكلمة (Word Families)

text: Many questions ask for **the correct form of the word in brackets**. Learn the noun, verb, adjective and adverb together.

blocks.text: الجدول ده فيه أشهر عيلات الكلمات في الوحدة. الخانة اللي فيها (—) يعني مفيش شكل مشهور منها في المستوى ده.
إزاي أعرف محتاج أنهي شكل من الكلمة؟

text: Look at the word **before** and **after** the gap. The position tells you if you need a noun, a verb, an adjective or an adverb.

blocks.text: في سؤال **Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets** بص على مكان الفراغ:
كلمات بتيجي مع بعض (Collocations)

text: A **collocation** is a group of words that native speakers usually use together. Using them makes your writing sound natural.

blocks.text: الـ collocation يعني كلمتين «متجوزين»: لازم تستخدمهم مع بعض. مثلًا بنقول **reach a compromise** (أو make a compromise) ومنقولش do a compromise. احفظهم كده:

rows: Nour **launched a campaign** to clean beaches.
Groups **lobby the government** to protect wetlands.
We must **take action** before it is too late.
Fishermen **earn a livelihood** from the sea.

blocks.text: البادئات واللواحق (Prefixes & Suffixes)

text: A **prefix** comes at the start of a word and often changes its meaning. A **suffix** comes at the end and often changes the word class (noun, adjective…).

blocks.text: الـ **prefix** حتة في **أول** الكلمة وغالبًا بتعكس المعنى. الـ **suffix** حتة في **آخر** الكلمة وبتقولك هي اسم ولا صفة ولا ظرف. ده بيساعدك في سؤال الـ correct form وفي إنك تخمّن معنى كلمة جديدة.
المرادفات والأضداد (Synonyms & Antonyms)

text: Reviews often ask you to **find words in the text that are synonyms or antonyms** of given words. Learn the pairs below.

blocks.text: فقرة بالكلمات الجديدة
اقرا الفقرة دي وركّز على الكلمات اللي بالـ bold. كلها من الوحدة، ولاحظ إزاي اتحطت في سياق طبيعي:

text: Every autumn, a **staggering** number of **migratory** birds cross our skies. They depend on a chain of **wetlands**, and each **stopover** belongs to a different country. If one wetland is **drained**, the **consequences** are felt far away. That is why **conservationists** say that protecting wildlife is a shared **responsibility**.

Last year, a group of students in Hurghada **launched a campaign** to remove **discarded** nets from the beach. At first, some fishermen had **objections** because fishing is their **livelihood**. After a long **negotiation**, both sides **reached a compromise**: donations would pay for safer nets. The students also planted mangroves and recorded **measurable** results, such as less **coastal erosion**. Their project shows that **global citizenship** is not an **abstract** idea. It starts with one beach and real **engagement**.

blocks.text: لاحظ: الفقرة فيها **reached a compromise** و**launched a campaign** (collocations)، وفيها كلمات من عيلات مختلفة: conservationists (اسم شخص) و measurable (صفة). استخدم نفس الأسلوب لما تكتب الـ email في الـ Summative Task.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ do a compromise ← ✓ **reach / make** a compromise
✗ Fishing is their live. ← ✓ Fishing is their **livelihood**. (الاسم مش الفعل)
✗ The project gave measure results. ← ✓ The project gave **measurable** results. (قبل الاسم = صفة)
✗ conservation (عن شخص) ← ✓ **conservationist** = الشخص، conservation = عملية الحفاظ
✗ advocate about turtles ← ✓ advocate **for** turtles
✗ Poaching is unlegal. ← ✓ Poaching is **illegal**. (قبل l بنستخدم il-)

blocks.title: حيلة سريعة للحفظ وللامتحان
items: **-ist** = بني آدم: conservationist / activist / biologist.
في سؤال **in this context** ارجع للجملة وجرّب كل اختيار مكان الكلمة. الاختيار اللي يخلّي الجملة منطقية هو الصح.
في سؤال **antonyms from the text** دوّر في القطعة على كلمة من **نفس النوع** (صفة قصاد صفة، اسم قصاد اسم).
اربط كل كلمة بصورة من الوحدة: **tangled** = السلحفاة في الشبكة، **trampled** = الفيل في مزرعة Grace.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer: What does the word mean in this context?**

text: Many families in the village earn their livelihood from the river. What does "livelihood" mean in this context?
a. a protected habitat   b. a way of earning money   c. a short rest   d. a public campaign

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b.** الجملة بتقول «بيكسبوا ... من النهر» يعني مصدر رزقهم. الاختيارات التانية كلمات تانية من الوحدة (habitat / stopover / campaign) وده فخ متكرر.
**2) Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

text: Effective ________ (conserve) requires countries to work together.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: conservation.** قبل الفراغ صفة (effective) وبعده فعل (requires)، يبقى محتاجين **اسم** فاعل للجملة.
**3) Find the words in the text that are antonyms of the words below.**

text: The meeting ended in complete agreement. Everyone accepted the plan, and the dry land slowly became productive again.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** (a) **agreement** (b) **productive**. دوّرنا على اسم عكس disagreement، وصفة عكس barren.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. Funding for wetland projects is often the first thing cut when budgets tighten. What does "tighten" mean in this context?
a. become more limited  b. become more popular  c. become illegal  d. become stronger
items.a: **a. become more limited** — لما الفلوس تقل، الميزانية بتضيق.

items.q:
2. A large bird stopped at Lake Qarun for two days during its long journey south. The lake was a ________ for the bird.
a. corridor  b. stopover  c. compromise  d. campaign
items.a: **b. stopover** — محطة استراحة قصيرة في رحلة طويلة.

items.q:
3. Elephants trampled the farmer's young plants. What does "trampled" mean?
a. planted carefully  b. stepped heavily on and damaged  c. watered regularly  d. carried away

4. Illegal hunting of wild animals is called ________.
a. poaching  b. vegetation  c. stewardship  d. ecotourism

5. "Save the planet" can feel too abstract, so students prefer clear tasks like planting ten trees. The opposite of "abstract" is ________.
a. theoretical  b. enormous  c. concrete  d. general
items.a: **c. concrete** — abstract = فكرة نظرية، وعكسها حاجة ملموسة واضحة.

items.q:
6. Nour's beach clean-ups outlasted the anger that started them. This means the clean-ups ________.
a. ended quickly  b. continued longer than the anger  c. made her angrier  d. replaced the fishermen
items.a: **b** — outlast = يفضل موجود أطول من حاجة تانية.

items.q:
7. Ordinary volunteers collect data about birds for a local study. This is an example of ________.
a. citizen science  b. habitat loss  c. enforcement  d. paralysis
items.a: **a. citizen science** — ناس عادية بتجمع بيانات علمية كمتطوعين.

blocks.text: **B. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

items.q: 8. The project produced ________ (measure) results that the council could evaluate.
9. Renewable energy is essential for long-term environmental ________ (sustain).
10. Many ________ (conserve) believe that wetlands must be protected.
11. Strict ________ (enforce) of fishing rules protects sea turtles.
12. Every year, millions of birds ________ (migrate) across the Mediterranean.
items.a: **migrate** — بعد الفاعل محتاجين فعل في المضارع البسيط.

items.q: 13. We should use water ________ (responsible) because it is a finite resource.
14. Students showed great ________ (engage) in the mangrove project.

blocks.text: **C. Read the text, then find the words or phrases that are synonyms or antonyms of the words below.**

text: Last spring, our village faced a serious problem. Plastic waste was reaching the river at a worrying speed. At first, people could not agree, but after a long meeting they finally reached an agreement. Volunteers collected the thrown-away bags, and the riverbank, which had been dry and empty, became productive again. The effort was long: it continued for many months.

items.q: 15. A synonym of "alarming rate"
16. An antonym of "disagreement"
17. A synonym of "discarded"
18. An antonym of "fertile" (an adjective)
items.a: **dry and empty** — وصف الأرض قبل ما تبقى خصبة (barren).

items.q: 19. An antonym of "brief"

blocks.text: **D. Complete the text with words from the box.**

text: livelihood – compromise – campaign – discarded – advocate – lobby

items.q: 20. Nour started a ________ to clean the beaches of Hurghada.
21. She found a turtle caught in a ________ fishing net.
22. Fishermen said the sea was their ________, so changing nets was costly.
23. After long talks, both sides accepted a ________: safer nets paid for by donations.
24. Volunteers ________ the local council to ban plastic bags near the shore.
items.a: **lobby** — يضغطوا على المسؤولين علشان يدعموا قضية.

items.q: 25. We must ________ for animals because they cannot speak for themselves.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: كلمات الوحدة بتدور حول: **الحيوانات والموارد المشتركة** (migratory, finite, wetland)، **الصراع على الأرض** (livelihood, poaching, corridor)، **الدفاع عن البيئة** (advocate, campaign, lobby, compromise) و**المواطنة العالمية** (biodiversity, stewardship, measurable).
احفظ عيلة الكلمة: conserve → conservation → conservationist / measure → measurable / sustain → sustainability.
احفظ الـ collocations: **reach** a compromise, **launch** a campaign, **lobby** the government, **file** a complaint.
في سؤال **in this context** رجّع الكلمة للجملة. وفي الـ antonyms دوّر على كلمة من **نفس النوع**.
